notes.title: Die After Sunset In Depth - Waikiki Beach
notes.content:
Welcome Defenders to where it all starts - [b]Waikiki Beach![/b]

We thought that we would take a break from the road to 1.0 to share with you some awesome concept art and level design of our first level in Die After Sunset.

[h3][b]IN THE BEGINNING...[/b][/h3]
In the year 2019, you spawn into the home of golden sand, broken roads and rubber inflatables!

We wanted to make a common place where many people like to visit and a symbol of leisure and enjoyment and Waikiki Beach is a perfect start to that narrative. 

[h3][b]POINTS OF INTEREST[/b][/h3]
On our map we have 6 points of interest that splits up the map which are all different based on the environment. The mission is of course inspired by the Hawaiian beach of Waikiki. The iconic Loulu palm trees, huts and bright blue water is what we tried to capture in our level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/123626115e55edd1968bc8e023f9baa9b0715abb.png[/img]

[b]WAIKIKI BEACH[/b]
This is where you start on the mission to fight back the Murkors through time. There is plenty of beach equipment left on the shore and Murkors are already ready to stop you...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/b8aca9948793fbc6b7b166d50a4d7b23988b07b6.png[/img]

[b]ABANDONED SHIP BAY[/b]
Our main icon on this map is the wrecked ship found on the far right corner of the environment. Of course, like all ships, there is treasure to be found so make sure to explore it. The ship bay is linked to caves linking it to the large car accident area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/fdc77b786393ed9fc3a86ba5647d66e2d1c57c70.png[/img]

[b]CRASH ACCIDENT[/b]
this is more directly in the middle of the map where you will be visiting the most as it links to majority of the other places of interest and to the boss of the level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/1053cdf84844de7853ee1a963ad61ed76e4bf374.png[/img]

[b]SECOND LEVEL[/b]
To add some variety, we wanted to add some vertical gameplay to the map. So we will have both walk paths and jump pads to keep your game flowing naturally... But, be careful you don't fall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/dcf4f6b805b3463fb1926dc71c829d1f1c9e0675.png[/img]

[b]NORTH BEACH[/b]

As we were designing the northern beach area, we decided to create a fun space for missions that would feel like a secret hideout tucked away at the back of the map. To keep things simple, we added some beachy accessories and changing rooms, but who knows what other surprises we might have in store? Maybe we left some hidden chests around, or even perched them on top of some towering rocks for an extra challenge. The possibilities are endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/9ff38b2138b830eafce360821bb09c1e54f0c552.png[/img]

[b]DOCK AND MARKET[/b]

The highlight of this section of the map is the fish market building, complete with a mid-size interior. Plus, like any good dock, we've strategically placed shipping containers around the perimeter to keep the game flow running smoothly. And don't worry, you'll have no trouble navigating to the second level when you need to. It's all about fun and ease here at our market and dock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/b703e68fe7e83ad68970abf36280f885b0f40bdc.png[/img]

[h3][b]UNIQUE FEATURES[/b][/h3]

The theme of Waikiki Beach revolves around the playful and whimsical nature of our game. Our iconic inflatables, often donned by the Murkors, are scattered throughout the map, embodying this lighthearted theme. We make sure to incorporate the setting and atmosphere into each map's unique theme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/9a2b99817c17f507d36b4f1f4cf576ba3d1c4a5b.png[/img]

That is all to be said today defenders. Stick around to see more exclusive concept art and content.

notes.title: Die After Sunset New Mission - Shootout
notes.content:
[b]Welcome Back Defenders![/b]

We have a great  variety of missions that randomises in each level and play through. But we're happy to give you a sneak peak to a brand new mission coming very soon - Shootout!

[h3][b]WHAT DO I DO?[/b][/h3]
The mission can be found much like any other activity on the map. Which means luck will be involved, as all the missions are randomly generated. Once you have found the mission, approach the saloon bar and prepare to shoot some of those darn Murkors. Each Murkor you shoot will achieve points, 15 or 30 points to be exact. 

And yes, even your friendly helpers can shoot the Murkors too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/b5c185e40f9040f82892db902b953ccb42464ab9.gif[/img]

[h3][b]IS IT THAT EASY?[/b][/h3]

Well not entirely. Some of us might be hitting bullseyes all the time, but you have to be careful not to shoot the dynamite which might pop up time to time. These will reduce 100 points that you earned so be careful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/dd7ce5f5dd8c60fd0133d70ead76c7ff1597fb30.png[/img]

With heavy losses comes with great rewards. We will rarely pop up a few moneybags as well as the Murkors. If you shoot at these bags will reward you with 100 points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/1c3ecaeadb74154cbc268d640846c1e4f46692fd.png[/img]

[h3][b]WHAT'S NEXT? [/b][/h3]

Once the timer is over, you will receive your prize depending on what score you get. The higher the score the more prizes is received. 

Of course this isn't the only mission we have been working on so stick around!

notes.title: Die After Sunset Road To 1.0 - Player Animations
notes.content:
It's that time again defenders for some more [b]UPDATES![/b]

Last time we looked at the enemy reactions and how they change based on the players actions. Now it is  time to look at the characters animations!

[h3][b]NEW IDLE ANIMATIONS[/b][/h3]
One way to give our characters some more personality is to add some idle animations. These are triggered if you wait around for a while without moving, which will be relatively difficult considering Murkers will be chasing you a lot! 

However, when you can activate these animations they really make the character feel more.....well human. This has been implemented to April, Hune and of course Rido as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/49ee262819200921f10ccf32f384af3dc4dfc6a1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]NEW CHEST ANIMATION[/b][/h3]
Gone of the days where a box will magically open from a touch of a button. We have applied a new animation where the character will now crouch to unlock the box. It's the little things that increases our immersion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/2f2dcbbdabeec8549981ef9384fb961717cf39a2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]CHARACTER'S HEAD FOLLOWS THE CAMERA[/b][/h3]
To help build on a more immersive 3rd person experience we felt it is really important to implement head movement depending on where you put your camera. This small feature makes the character feel more alive and helps align when your are dealing with those pesky Murkers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/7091e0427b7a658593ffedb93c197cdb56cb66c1.gif[/img]
This is just the start of all small changes that we are making in the road to 1.0 and we are excited to show you more.

[b]Stay Tuned![/b]

notes.title: Die After Sunset Road To 1.0 - Enemy Reactions
notes.content:
[h2][b]Nice to see you back defenders![/b][/h2]

The Murkors are a large part of our game with so many different designs and characteristics. We felt like it was important to provide these little devils with some more personality. While we are changing up the enemies behaviour and weaponry,  we would first like to show you an overhaul of new animations when they react to the players actions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/95135dd94f64eab8c0d62299a372fa2b26282cb1.gif[/img]


[h3][b]THEY REALLY DON'T LIKE YOU NOW![/b][/h3]

We felt like the Murkors didn't show enough emotion when they are literally being shot at and seeing a heroic protagonist lay rest to there friends. So we have decided to make them more angrier than before. when you shoot or approach a Murkor, they can show their displeasure to you now, showing that your presence is not amusing to them at all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/c2e35f5c56c878039300f1e1309f651ba32b9863.png[/img]


[h3][b]ABILITIES WILL SHOW AN EFFECT[/b][/h3]

There are many different weapons and equipment that you will have at your disposal and each item will make the Murkor react to it. For example if you throw a stun grenade at some Murkors they will look classically confused and disorientated. We have done this with a good amount of abilities that is in your disposal.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/b0f6c5e35bfee873c1a5088b621ed498173ad112.png[/img]

[h3][b]SO OVER DRAMATIC![/b][/h3]

As you take a Murkors health away they can look pretty angry, but what happens if they run out of health. well we have an animation for when the die which can look pretty dramatic. 


[h3][b]MORE TO COME![/b][/h3]

We will continue to frequently update you on our road to 1.0 and if you would like to see some exclusive content head over to our Discord server!

https://discord.gg/vseKzEQg

[b]Until again Defenders![/b]

notes.title: Character Breakdown: Who Should You Play?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/4611873b0b5415cdf2cd59d5900dd56a882a34f7.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Gamers![/b]

The classic scenario we always face when we start a new game with multiple playable characters, is which character do we play? We need to weigh up our play style and what suits this best and also the particular strengths of each player too.

Well, we have put together a little breakdown of each character’s strongest abilities and things to consider when making this difficult decision. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/5325c2a3afb2de845419641a2a48f53aac7054ca.png[/img]

[b]Why should I play:[/b]

[h2][u]April[/u][/h2]

First off, we have our original hero, April. Her character build is [b]very good for beginners[/b] and starting out playing Die After Sunset. She has good manoeuvrability including a [b]great dodging ability[/b] in which she rolls away from danger. This can also help you travel around the map a lot faster as well if you use in conjunction with the dashing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/c60b72e8c403eee16ec37658e8c7ca509730b765.png[/img]

April has the basic gun, which is again, a great weapon to ease you into things and figuring out the aiming. You can upgrade this during your runs with mission rewards or alternatively you can progress on the meta-map outside of your runs on the start menu. The other weapon April can wield is a shotgun which is much more powerful and can destroy murkors with one shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/5d922a4ec8ae0293673c0199753cbb3f279d7919.gif[/img]

The only real drawback to April is that she isn’t a particularly exciting character, in that she doesn’t have anything extraordinary about her. But that is the whole idea! She is meant to be [b]an everyday citizen,[/b] the normest of the norm, dragged into a battle for Earth by the Murkor Invasion. April will work well with beginners and for [b]all round attack and also defensive gamers.
[/b]
[h2][u]Rido[/u][/h2]

Next up for selection, we have our second [b]rogue hero[/b], Rido. He appears as a new ally to unlock in the game from [b]level 2, treasure island. [/b]Rido has a unique backstory and that explains his rather unique appearance as well. Finding himself short on cash, Rido joined the army’s human testing division and ultimately became a mixture of man and robot. After fleeing their facility, he has remained on the run ever since and slap bang in the middle of a war!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/a52359cab1fdf3f694640aebfcde3e9b55ddc0b6.png[/img]

One good thing to come from his backstory, however, is his [b]powerful fighting ability[/b]. His most advantageous weapon is his [b]machinegun[/b] which can pepper any enemy full of holes! This in itself is a big appeal however, Rido also has [b]super-fast and strong robotic legs[/b] too! These can give you a super-fast dash and also a [b]powerful swift kick[/b] to slam those pesky Murkors. This robotic tech can be upgraded in the start menu once you build up your skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/90da7e81b5727cc0792361b590a2da9e8ba5eb61.gif[/img]

As great as Rido sounds though, his manoeuvrability is a lot slower and broken compared to April due to his oddly shaped robotic legs. Arguably however he does make up for this with the super strong leg abilities, but they do have cool downs to be careful of! Rido would suit a combative attack focused gamer.

[h2][u]Hune[/u][/h2]

And last up to consider is Hune. Not much is known about Hune or how she came to be, however what we do know is she was kidnapped by the enemy murkors and supposedly experimented on creating an unstable power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/a51129a3cc8cbd15411940eb47801ca85971fbcc.png[/img]

Despite her stability being in question, she can be a useful asset in the fight against the murkors now. Her unique abilities include teleportation giving her a huge advantage with manoeuvrability. She also floats around the map which gives her another upper hand on the enemies and her fellow allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/1d6b15f4f30e0b3eeac53fe62596dd7508a5cc12.gif[/img]

And that’s not all, Hune also defies gravity with her gravity distorting hoop weapon. Throwing this at the enemy will cause them to be stunned and lose all gravity just like Hune herself making them easy targets to take down. Couple this with her small finger gun, which granted is probably the weakest of the weapons, but it has a great power up to blast those enemies down. Hune lends herself well to gamers who favour speed and manoeuvrability.

With this individual breakdown of each character, you can now make an informed decision on which character to play and would suit your play style. [b]Happy gaming gamers![/b]

notes.title: Murkor Invasion Log #8: The Distillery is Going to Explode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/e9e907a3e2cdcd0d396a447b9e40c1d0d30419d0.png[/img]

[b]Gather Round People![/b]

As always we have new updates for you all with the latest on the Murkors current destruction. The Murkors have been causing mayhem once again at a local distillery. We must work together to make sure they don’t cause irreversible damage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/0c16e6d38d91c037e42b8575be209df7eca6ab96.png[/img]

[i]April reporting in from the scene!

It appears the Murkors have clogged the distillery in an attempt to build pressure within the still. If the pressure reaches a critical point then we will have a very large boom on our hands, so the best thing to do is to focus on reaching the top and releasing the valve to discharge the built up pressure.

The Murkors are not going to make things easy for you though so be ready to fight your way to the top. I would recommend carrying a reliable weapon and also any tech to help your jumping ability would be hugely useful to see this mission end well.

Make sure any additional tools you pick up give you the advantage in close combat with the Murkors. Tools such as grenades or detachable turrets will not be helpful for scaling the still and may even hinder or harm your progression to the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/8ff9a927c7926f86153cfd7935e7bbe154e43ccb.gif[/img]

Keep your head, this is a time sensitive mission so be sure to move swiftly and precisely and hopefully all we will be cleaning up is Murkor Mukus at the end of the day![/i]

notes.title: Die After Sunset: What's the Story?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/f97620e6fb58d0da5e35481631e23f24e5f35038.png[/img]

[b]What's up peeps![/b]

We have been busy working away on further game improvements to bring out the best of Die After Sunset, but in the meantime we thought it would be cool to share with you a little bit about the story within the game so you can really connect with the characters.

[u]Where it all begins...[/u]

An alien race capable of traveling through time known as the Murkors has completely conquered the planet overnight. No one knows how they got here, but everyone feels as if they have always been among us. The Murkors, negatively affected by the light of the Sun, have been able to extinguish it. One last city resists the attacks of the creatures, it is the day of the final battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/928fe099f86dba3763767e15f0a930d8bafb1cc3.gif[/img]

[b]April Blazestrong[/b], a rookie officer, is part of the troops defending the city when she is caught in an explosion and dies in combat. She immediately wakes up in her apartment that same morning, with a difference: In the middle of the apartment is a strange artefact new to April. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/48d6209eefd32132a3ff2f015ce8ce7047c3e5f1.gif[/img]

A voice coming from it tells her that it comes from the future and she is the only chance to save humanity. She has been locked in a time loop and has two choices: Go out the door and die again in the same battle or help her stop the Murkor invasion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/371cbcf8d2b20a473fbf54e4a8ca7ff70ac961ce.gif[/img]

[u]What happens next...[/u]

The voice will guide April through a series of locations through time to stop the invasion, prevent them from shutting down the Sun and save Earth from its terrible fate. In these locations, the Murkors have modified the history of mankind to bring us to the terrible, dark present that our protagonist knows. Stopping the alien leaders who caused these changes is the main objective, but playing with a time loop is dangerous and as you solve missions they will be mixed between eras, leaving the fabric of time in a very delicate state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/118e2523e5788ba3b6bc333c6c2aea09193adc14.gif[/img]

[u]The Invaded Timelines[/u]

[list]
[*] High Waikiki Beach, Year 2019
[*] Treasure Island, Year 1701
[*] Mock Town, Year 1849
[*] Yggdrasil, Year 841
[*] The End of the World, Year 2120
[/list]
Luckily you will have all the opportunities you need to achieve your goal: every time you die you return to the apartment and the loop begins again. Each time April manages to get further; the reality through the window from the skyscraper she lives in changes for the better. The only way out will be to reach the end and see the birth of a new day.

[b]Greetings![/b]

We have a rather strange one today folks…April has sent over a mission report for our attention and the Murkors seem to have taken a liking to our swimwear?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/482f474ae4f010c5d0c4fb4476d1ca7d634fb19b.png[/img]

[i]Reporting in with a bizarre mission report today…I came across a group of [b]Murkors stealing swimwear [/b]from the beach huts! It seems they were quite taken with the beachwear for some reason, my thoughts are they wanted to use them for some sort of scheme to blend in more on Earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/a9cb8dec2e28d1953ee47e8e8f7a42e383b373ad.png[/img]

If this should happen again then keep directing your attacks on the Murkors stealing the swimwear while dodging the others.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/303d2cab6a78c59e4f28f713ed329587e028beab.png[/img]

[b]Listen Closely![/b]

We have another invaluable report from April today who is still fighting the good fight out on the field. It seems there are [b]Murkor nests growing[/b] on Waikiki Beach, and we cannot allow more enemies to spawn so be sure to pay attention to this briefing!

April’s communication states:

[i]My latest goal has been to try and learn more about the Murkors themselves and I hit the jackpot while following a group of them today. I discovered a bunch of [b]Murkor nests growing[/b] by one of the cliffs on the beach and I knew this was a spawn point. I unfortunately arrived quite late into their development, so it appeared as though they were ready to burst. Instinct told me to not let that happen and so the race against time began as I stepped close to the nests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/1e6a9c0941dbed16c81566f6ac42fc6302157b09.png[/img]

The closer I came to the nests however, the more the Murkors leapt in to try and deter me from attacking them directly. It became apparent the best way to avoid the enemy attacks while focusing on the nests, was to keep a good distance between me and the nests. [b]The important thing is to keep moving so that you never become an easy target yourself.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/fd35e17051f99fc51b368e5ed20cbca85fe91c1f.gif[/img]

[b]Make sure to disperse your attacks evenly between all four of the nests[/b] in order to keep them from growing further. You have more than one attack at your disposal, so be sure to bring all the firepower you have for this mission’s success. As long as the nests don’t reach maturity within their limited growth period, then you will have completed your mission. On the other hand, a well-fought warrior would not leave enemies to spread the news of their nest being invaded, and so if you have the strength for it defeat and hold off the Murkors, while also attacking the nests in order to level up your win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/0e50b4387fe04aa02d4a28a8fbce90ce58b30e21.png[/img]

Watch each other’s backs out there, until next time!

- April out![/i]

notes.title: Murkor Invasion Log #2: Ruckus at the Museum

notes.title: Tools Vs Items: What's the difference?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/0edefdb762564246fde1f0e2be955e11aaf55a11.png[/img]

[b]Salutations everyone![/b]

It’s me the Chief Science Officer, back again to debrief you but this time on the very things that could turn the tide in battle against the Murkors…[b]Tools and Items![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/6b736690668dace206a9d3623312e913b9b13d69.png[/img]

In order to gain as much of an advantage as possible, we developed various equipment to be scattered around the invaded areas to aid in defeating the enemies. You will find them [b]housed inside a secure chest[/b] which only our agents can access, and each contains a unique piece of tech that can then be put to good use out in the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/f74edd49a965e39f9747c927dcfc829cfe9f1fc6.png[/img]

So now we have cleared up how you find these various pick-me-ups, let’s discuss how they differ from each other. You will be able to loot tools and items, but they work in different ways. 

[b]Tools[/b] are designed to be used by the agent and so requires [b]user interaction.[/b] They consist of things such as [b]Antigravity Grenades[/b] or [b]Decoys[/b] that you would consciously use in battle. As we learn and develop our technology, we will continue to add chests for you to make use of, which means it is possible to come across an [b]improved version[/b] of a tool we have already developed. We may also spice things up with [b]new variations[/b] too, like Fire and Ice tools for example as we learn what is effective against the various Murkors. Tools can be used [b]multiple times[/b], but do often have a [b]'cool down'[/b] period in between uses so be aware how much you are using your equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/192c743ef3717b82aecb2c5c08ad3502cc644ac6.gif[/img]

In comparison, [b]Items[/b] are much more [b]passive[/b] and once you pick them up they will continually aid you wherever is appropriate as you carry them in your inventory. You can only carry so much though, so be sure to weigh up the potential use of each item before committing to looting it. Some items you pick up will be [b]one time only[/b] and should be used wisely and others will [b]give you cool abilities[/b] you can harness either [b]continually or for a limited time[/b] to defeat the Murkors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/a1d522fc48e75c91dde82852c8f3cc9baa2bcf6c.gif[/img]

There are a lot of tools and items to find and consider so we will be [b]highlighting them individually over the web across various channels[/b] so be on the lookout for those updates.


- Until the next time!

notes.title: NEW LEVEL TEASER!
notes.content:
[h1]A SNEAK PEEK AT SOME NEW STUFF[/h1]
Before that, we want to say a big, big thank you to everyone who took part in the playtest recently. 

Between the BETA and the last Playtest, you've all given us a ton of feedback which we massively appreciate.

Since we turned off the playtest (sorry about that!) we've been hard at work implementing some of the feedback (and bugs!) you've all reported, ready for our next steps over the coming weeks.

The good news is that Die After Sunset will come out to play again very, very soon - as early as next week in fact, as we gear up for Next Fest which is looming over the horizon! And by 'horizon' we mean October the 1st.

One of the bonuses of not being in BETA or Playtest, is that we get to pour some of that Hot Dev Energy  back into making more content for the upcoming Early Access release. Specifically the Third Stage that will be included in the initial Early Access Release. 

Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/a1257a85a8dab7b2506652fdd18ccd25119d835e.jpg[/img]

[h2]1849 - MOCK TOWN - CHRISTMAS DAY[/h2]
Jingle Bells? Jingle Hell, more like. It seems the Murkors have found a [i]most diabolical way[/i] to destabilise humanity - stealing children's toys. 

A little while back we showed you a few early images of this stage and we're pleased to say it's all starting to come together really nicely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/7e1c8357aba87efb34508a05a95432109d05887d.jpg[/img]

The citizens of little Mock Town were definitely not prepared for the arrival of the Murkrampus (more on that later on!) and the consequences of stealing the dreams of an entire childhood. 

A dash of Western here, a little festive cheer there. This place is going to be [i]absolute chaos. [/i] It's nice to finally get some enemies into this place now and to start getting a feel for how it flows on each run.

Suffice to say, we won't be going easy on you in this one!

Hope you like what you see! Expect to see many more updates over the coming weeks. We're getting tantalisingly close to Early Access Release now, and we can't wait for you all to dive in!

All the best, you beautiful Murkor-slaughtering time travellers, you!
The Playstark and PQube team.

notes.title: Devlog #005
notes.content:
What's shakin', bacon?

Sorry we've been quite, its been a hectic couple of weeks at Playstark and PQube, with lots of changes and development updates happening in tandem. Here's what we've been up to!

First, the incredible Tom Waterhouse at [url=https://twitter.com/2dforever]2D Forever[/url] has redesigned our key art - and we couldn't be happier with it. It encapsulates the game perfectly, and is such a spectacular piece of art. Thanks again Tom, you rule. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/de729733979543b1549c627e640125c57a619431.jpg[/img]

On development, we've been hard at work with the 3rd new level - its Christmas in Mock Town! A stark contrast from the first two levels, it's time to round up those scoundrel Murkors and show this town who the real sherrif is. 
[h3][b]YEEHAW.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/dd65a3381aca8ac302a6ac6f9f23e47c7f657f48.png[/img]
[i][b]It's Christmas of 1849 - and someone real annoying has been stealing toys. [/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/aa94b5d1cb5eed94b8b50693ec7ea113ca335297.png[/img]
[i][b]You've yee'd your last haw, partner.[/b][/i]

As always, we've been adding a ton of new items that vary up each run. Ontop of new skills, weapons and abilities, we're adding in new stat changes that can drop. Shield regen speed, elemental resistance, skill and weapon coooldown, speed, damage block.....you get the idea.
The aim is always to make each run feel new and unique, so adding in a variety of new stat changes mid-run helps this, as well as allows for greater build diversity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/768f19df648e42314a766949e2fbfb96057fab02.png[/img]

We've been adding in some variance to run missions and quests, adding in new occourances in each level. This should keep you all nice and busy while you're getting murdered by adorable Murkors. Or while you figure out whatever on Earth is going on with this.....
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/98c1038506b27073c772668d086859b5550704a1.jpg[/img]

We've also been hard at work creating the new character and how that will operate in the world. We want to ensure play and build diversity, as well as synergy between players - so we are working hard at making sure new characters feel unique and different from one another. From different skill kits and weapon loadouts, to different roles in battle. We're trying out a variety of options to make sure we settle on something great. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/c95f0a97b6ef4836ffa68b5865108272128fca70.jpg[/img]

Finally, we want to let you all start creating some chaos in the world - so we're happy to announce we will be [b]realeasing a free demo starting on August 20th![/b] This demo will be accessible on the Steam page, and will only be showcasing the first level of the game. We want to let you all go hands on with Die After Sunset, so this short demo should give you a taste of whats availavble. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/feec0f0d58027a7af5b5e07526406f1da5aefe63.png[/img]

Aren't we the best to you guys? Awk, you don't have to say that. But if you do wan't to tell us how great we are, come do it in our [url=https://discord.gg/XEnXkugduT]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/PlaystarkGames]Twitter[/url].

Meet you there!

notes.title: Devlog #003
notes.content:
Hey guys, happy Monday! I hope you all have killer weeks ahead of you.

This devlog comes a little late, as things have been hectic this past week. A lot of final checks and balances had to be completed before our beta went live on Friday - which was a lot of work. We've seen so many of you create amazing content from the beta so far and will be highlighting some of it later in the week - so keep busting out some crazy runs and submit your clips, screenshots and memes into the [url=https://discord.gg/XEnXkugduT]Discord[/url]!

Outside of everything in the beta, we've been creating ideas for a bunch of new in-game quests. During your runs, procedural quests will pop up around the map which can be completed, or not, at your choosing. The better (and sometimes quicker!) you complete these quests, the better your reward. From little stat bumps, to time-warping grenades or cat turrets that rain hell on the Murkors - these rewards can sometimes take your run to the next level!

We have a bunch of quests already in the game, with a bunch more on the way. Let's check 'em out.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/dcd76992cb186a550d49d273b6c8e039e646c8dc.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Bathing suit robbery. The WORST kind of robbery. [/b][/i]

In this event, the Murkors are rushing from the beach shacks to the teleporter to steal swimming costumes. How RUDE. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/da6e6829e085148f3a8f7e13303ceebae2c22502.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Can we get some more light in here?[/b][/i]

This one is already in the game, but its great. When you learn how to do this one a couple of times, its an easy win for a 3 star completion to get that tasty tasty loot. Power up the generator and get some light back in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/32a5528fb3021ee223e9d3d3e27e08e532285e29.jpg[/img]
[i][b]This one is just....cool looking.[/b][/i]

What could this one be? Even I don't know what this one is. How mysterious!!

If any of this looks exciting to you, [url=https://pqube.co.uk/die-after-sunset/]sign up to be apart of our future playtests[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/XEnXkugduT]join our community[/url], and come and get stuck in the floor before we fix it. 
[h2]Rise up, pre bug-fix gang!!!
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ded44f5456e0f18f7a1e7a65d9e4713a2bfdee12.png[/img] 

We're loving all of the content we're seeing come out of the beta, so keep it coming, and we'll be checking in on it all this coming Friday in Devlog 4!!
Stay out the shade, legends.
